selection: Reuse the three already-trained circular baseline runs on this same dataset. Train the three declared candidates with the same seeds and training schedule. To replace baseline, mean joint-mirror validation MSE must improve by at least 1%; mean length MSE may increase at most 2%, dX MAE 5%, and dY MAE 2%. Choose the eligible candidate with minimum mean validation MSE; otherwise keep baseline. Deploy the median-validation seed. Freeze before test evaluation.
test_policy: Evaluate only the frozen selected variant and the baseline on the existing 100 test IDs, all three seeds. This test set has been examined in earlier rounds and is not a new blind holdout. Do not choose a different variant or seed from these test results. Sample 207 stays the fixed UI illustration, not a best-error selection.
quality_scope: Corrected generator2 2.2.0 top-metal 1000: thick SiO2 into lower PML / passive JC Au 100 nm / As2Se3 tetramer. Metal-only 8 nm, pipeline_validation. Train/validation-led inverse-model refinement; no forward network or new FDTD run.
